reader_summary.headline: I am @Compound248 and this is the next installment in our Business Breakdowns mini-series focused on Digital Infrastructure.
reader_summary.overview: I am @Compound248 and this is the next installment in our Business Breakdowns mini-series focused on Digital Infrastructure. In this episode, we will talk about a company that delivers that airbourne experience, Gogo. Known for its eponymous inflight WiFi service, Gogo is frequently misunderstood, having undergone a transformation to focus purely on the business, or private, aviation industry.

key_points.text: It sells equipment that gets installed on a private aviation airplane, and then, in infrastructure like fashion.
We’re fortunate to be joined by Oak Thorne, who has led Gogo for 20 years into the success it is today.
